|rulings=* Works with substituted draws (e.g. a destiny value obtained from [[Smoke Screen]] would count as Light's draw).<ref name="scomp" />
* Modifiers to individual battle destiny draws are applied before comparing them to see which is higher.
* Compare the battle destinies as an automatic action just after both players have finished drawing (or substituting) their one battle destiny.
* Resets opponent's ''total'' battle destiny to an unmodifiable 0.
* Works with [[I Don't Like Sand]] - limits both players to 1 battle destiny draw, then is able to reduce opponent's ''total'' to 0 (the individual draw may not be modified, but the total may be modified).
|combos=* [[Smoke Screen]] - Easily get a high destiny, reducing opponent's total to 0.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Kal%27Falnl%20C%27ndros Scomp: Kal'Falnl C'ndros]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* [[I Don't Like Sand]] - Cause both players to draw only one battle destiny, setting up KFC. KFC's text does work with Sand, reducing opponent's total to 0.

A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 18 April 2016. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-kalfalnlcndros-PC-Errata-2016-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again, with the printed art, title and lore (348 × 489 pixels); a small round bronze disc at the lower right marks it as errata.

The 2013 slip and the same area of the 2016 disc card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
